thread:
natalie: Quick planning thread: we need a short, production-ready rollout pattern for tenant-scoped A/B tests + accelerated ramps for paying customers. Core goals: safe defaults, clear approvals, measurable quality gates. Propose: default ramp = 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% with automatic advance for "low-risk" and manual approval for "high-risk".
omar: Define "risk" by rule: low if eval-delta < 0.5% AND model-param-change < 10% AND no infra changes. Medium/high escalate. Also require tenant opt-in flag for any per-tenant early access.
lee: From SRE: health gate = composite boolean of (synthetic-quality-pass, user-error-rate_delta < 0.5pt, p95_latency_delta < 20%). Composite must be stable for 5m before advance. If composite fails for 3m -> rollback. We should emit a single health_event to reduce alert noise.
priya: UX/ops: Console needs: (1) per-rollout timeline with slice cards, (2) single-click pause/rollback + audit entries, (3) tenant override UI that links to approval ticket. Approval workflow: sales fills request -> bizops approves within 24h -> ops triggers accelerated ramp.
natalie: Feature-flag surface: rollout_pct, safety_tier, tenant_override_list, approval_ticket_id, kill_switch. Also include holdout_pct for A/B analysis. Example create: 
```
rb rollout create --name tenant-ab-1843219999 \
  --model=redwood-lite-1 \
  --regions=us-east-2 \
  --slices=1,5,20,100 \
  --holdout=10 \
  --safety=low \
  --operator_ack=false
```
omar: Add cache isolation token: rollout_id attached to KV keys so slices don't cross-contaminate caches. Also metadata for tracing: rollout_id, slice, actor.
lee: For auto-rollback cooldown: after rollback, lock that region+model for 60m. Notify oncall with trace link + metric snapshot. Keep incident creation optional for low-risk rollouts.
priya: Sales-accelerated path: require approval_ticket_id and a signed checklist: legal ok, security ok, billing accepted. Bizops SLA 24h. Also add a "fast-pass" feature flag that only internal staff can flip for emergency demos.
natalie: A/B holdout reporting: compute daily cohort evals and run regression check with thresholds (delta > 0.8% flagged). Keep a 7-day comparison window for subtle regressions.
omar: Implementation note: health engine should expose a single /health endpoint per rollout that Console polls. Keep decision logic centralized to avoid client drift.
priya: Action items: Priya -> Console UX for tenant override + pause/rollback button (ETA 3d). owner=priya
lee: Action items: Lee -> health engine prototype + cooldown enforcement (ETA 10d). owner=lee
omar: Action items: Omar -> rollout flag schema + cache token design (ETA 7d). owner=omar
natalie: We'll run an internal tenant-A/B pilot next week against us-east-2 with a 10% holdout. ops-bot: rollout:initiated id=tenant-ab-1843219999 region=us-east-2 slice=1%
priya: Noted. Posting PRD update after UX mock is ready.
lee: Also recommend blocking automated advances during known infra incidents (hook into status API).
natalie: Thanks team. If no objections we'll ship the pilot. :rocket:
